name: kind-durable-provider-provisioning-recovery
instr:
kind cannot resume interrupted cluster creation from durable, provider-verified progress without recreating resources or repeating completed lifecycle work. Make recovery opt-in through a `CreateOption` in the public library and the create-cluster command. Leave ordinary creation unchanged.

Recovery records must be atomic, durable, exclusively owned, tied to the effective provisioning configuration, and limited to acknowledged progress. Reject malformed, truncated, mismatched, or no-longer-owned state before provider mutation.

Every provider, including Docker, nerdctl or Finch, and Podman, must conservatively reconcile recorded progress with discoverable runtime resources and reject incompatible artifacts. Docker must preserve configured node order when reconciling concurrent containers and its effective network. nerdctl must preserve serial order and executable identity. Podman must validate runtime compatibility, normalized images, and associated volumes.

Continue from the safe lifecycle boundary confirmed by reconciliation. Never repeat completed provisioning or actions; incomplete work remains repeatable. Keep cleanup and recovery state consistent through failures and interruptions. Discard records only after cleanup completes. Retained failures preserve resources and resumable state.
